Bacterial_Wilt.quote: the leaves turn a dull green color, and a progressive wilting of lateral leaves occurs
The pathogen moves through the main stem, plugging the vascular tissue
eventually causes wilting and death of entire plants

Downy_Mildew.quote: Downy mildew causes angular, yellow to brown lesions on top of the leaves that are restricted by leaf veins.
lesions observed on the underside of the leaf may be covered in dark 'down'

Powdery_Mildew.quote: White, powdery fungal growth develops on both leaf surfaces, petioles, and stems.

Yellow_Mosaic_Virus.quote: Fruit that is discolored and distorted, including raised lumps
